entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?

Hi... yes, I hope you can help. I bought some cycling shoes a while ago, and I think I need to return them. I was looking at the website and I'm just so confused by all the policies. It's a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help clear that up for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I'm not sure... they just hurt. I've tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times but no matter what I do, I end up with terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. I just don't think they're the right fit for me. Can't you just help me?

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me pull up your account information. Can you confirm the order number or the email address used for the purchase?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Road Cycling Shoes, delivered on October 18th. That was 51 days ago.
Oh dear, is that too long? I told you I was confused. I should have called sooner.
Not at all. I've just checked our policy for standard items, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with them. Thank you.

Of course. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. As a thank you for your loyalty, I'm also adding a credit to your account for a complimentary virtual fitting session. That way, for your next pair, our experts can help you get the perfect fit from the start.
Wow, that's incredible. I didn't even know you offered that. Thank you so much, Diana.

You're very welcome. I'm emailing the prepaid return label to you now. Just pack the shoes in any box, attach the label, and drop it off at your local post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive it. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's perfect. You've been a huge help.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
